changes.before: I narrowed my eyes. “You think too small, Buddy. Too small.”
changes.after:
I narrowed my eyes. “You think too small, Buddy. Too small.”

He got up, walked to the far end of the rug, and turned three times before lying down.

“Where are you going?”

“Out of whispering range.”

I followed. This required a briefing.

changes.before: Sagar, the King, stood tall with his arms crossed, surveying his domain. Heather, radiant as ever, sat upon the royal bench, sipping iced tea like the Lady of Elegance she is.
changes.after: Sagar stood with his arms crossed, surveying the park. Heather sat on the bench with an iced tea. Neither had requested my perimeter report. A troubling start.

changes.before: Buddy was already belly-up in the mulch. “You know this park is literally made for playing, right?”
changes.after: Buddy had found a patch of sun and was already belly-up in the mulch. “You know this park is literally made for playing, right?”

changes.before: The leaf landed softly. I stood over it, fur puffed, tail erect, and let out a final warning bark just in case it had friends.
changes.after: The leaf landed softly. I stood over it, chest out, nub rigid, and let out a final warning bark just in case it had friends.

changes.before: The other dogs stared. Let them. Greatness always looks weird to the uninformed.
changes.after:
The other dogs stared. Let them. Greatness always looks weird to the uninformed.

Buddy rolled onto his side. The leaf stuck to his shoulder.

“Hold still,” I said.

He shook. It landed behind me.

I turned. He settled back into his patch of sun. Apparently I was now securing both ends of the park.

changes.before: Sagar took to the kitchen in a whirlwind of spices and divine intentions.
changes.after: Sagar took to the kitchen in a whirlwind of spices and very confident estimates.

changes.before: The aroma filled the air. Buddy and I began pre-meal maneuvers
changes.after: The aroma filled the air. Buddy and I began pre-meal maneuvers:

changes.before: - Stage 3: Place head on thigh. Activate pity protocol.
changes.after:
- Stage 3: Place head on thigh. Activate pity protocol.

Buddy skipped Stage 2 and placed his chin on Heather’s knee. She scratched his ears. I was still inching forward. It was irritating to see a procedure work better without the procedure.

- Sat with back turned dramatically.

Buddy stayed facing the table.

“You’ll miss her getting up,” he said.

I adjusted my protest.

changes.before: Buddy licked his paw. “It’s hot inside anyway.”
changes.after:
Buddy licked his paw. “It’s hot inside anyway.”

He got up to investigate the rectangle of carpet where the mattress had been. It smelled wonderfully of us. He circled once and lay down in the middle.

“You’re accepting this?”

“I’m accepting the extra room.”

changes.before: And sure enough, the wind picked up. A chill arrived.
changes.after:
And sure enough, the wind picked up. A chill arrived.

No rain, technically. I considered this a minor clerical matter.

changes.before: I didn’t say anything. I just gave Sagar my quiet forgiveness.
changes.after:
I didn’t say anything. I just gave Sagar my quiet forgiveness.

Buddy stayed where the mattress belonged. Sagar had to put down his pillows and negotiate.
